# notion2feishu

> Migrate Notion pages to Feishu (Lark) docs, preserving hierarchy, images, and page links.

## Install

- `pipx install .` (from this repo)
- or `npx --yes github:niexia/notion2feishu`
- Requires Python 3.9+ and `lark-cli` logged in as a user.

## Commands

- `notion2feishu` — local Web wizard (connect, select, run)
- `notion2feishu scan --json` — list accessible Notion roots
- `notion2feishu pull --page <url> --out <dir> --json` — pull Notion to local Markdown
- `notion2feishu migrate --notion-page <url> --target wiki --space-id my_library` — end-to-end
- `notion2feishu migrate --src export.zip` — local export path
- `notion2feishu doctor` — auth diagnostics

## Safety

- Tokens only via `NOTION_TOKEN` env or local config.
- Always dry-run before writing; never delete Feishu docs.
- See `AGENTS.md` and `README.md`.
